beats.text: The USA has 7.1 times the liquid assets Angola has relative to its economy.
In Angola, this pool of exchange tools is just 14 percent.
It counts instruments widely accepted for exchange, plus those converted to cash at short notice.
Nigeria has 29 percent and Pakistan has 41 percent.
The climb continues: Indonesia has 43 percent, Mexico has 48 percent, and Russia has 70 percent.
The USA is one of the highest at 99.7 percent, nearly equal to its entire annual income.
How much liquid money circulates in your economy?
